display.purpose: One hero/section-headline moment per page. Never body copy or UI chrome.

body.purpose: Everything a visitor actually reads: paragraphs, labels, buttons, nav.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Current elevation for floating cards (Features, FAQ, ProductRow). Flagged in DESIGN.md Do's and Don'ts as heavier/darker than the calm Field Office foundation calls for — soften toward a lighter, more diffused shadow in future component work.

shadows.name: cta-primary
shadows.purpose: Tinted shadow under the primary (Deep Pine) CTA button.

shadows.name: cta-secondary
shadows.purpose: Tinted shadow under the secondary (Bright Mint) CTA button.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition speed for borders, backgrounds, shadows.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered entrance animation (Framer Motion whileInView), ease-out, fires once per session (viewport once:true).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Deep Pine fill, white text, calendar icon, scales up on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: #005647; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,86,71,0.3); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0a3d35; transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(1); } .ds-btn-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bright Mint fill CTA, used as the alternate/lighter action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: #00dba0; color: #005647; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,219,160,0.2); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #00c2a8; transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(1); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Translucent glass button for use over the network canvas or photographic/dark surfaces (e.g. WhatsApp CTA).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transform: scale(1.03); }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Floating white card with an accent icon tile; the base card pattern reused across Features, Services, and info grids.
components.html:
Título de la función

Descripción breve del beneficio para el visitante.
components.css: .ds-card-feature { border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,86,71,0.1); background: #ffffff; padding: 24px 32px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-card-feature:hover { border-color: rgba(0,219,160,0.4); } .ds-card-feature-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 16px; background: #1c1c1c; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-card-feature-title { margin-top: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #1c1c1c; } .ds-card-feature-desc { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: #666666; }

components.name: Content Panel
components.description: Large rounded panel used for grouped content (FAQ list, contact form) — same floating language at larger scale.
components.html:
Contanos tu proyecto

Dejanos tus datos y te respondemos a la brevedad.
components.css: .ds-panel { border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,86,71,0.1); background: #ffffff; padding: 32px 40px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #1c1c1c; } .ds-panel-desc { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #666666; }

components.name: Product Row Banner
components.description: Dark, full-width product banner (Deep Pine fill, white text) — the one inverted card variant in the system, used to introduce Mannaz/Odal on the products index.
components.html:
Mannaz

CRM para gestionar afiliados, campañas y visitas en un solo lugar.
components.css: .ds-product-row { position: relative; border-radius: 32px; background: #005647; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); overflow: hidden; padding: 24px; } .ds-product-row-title { margin: 0; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; } .ds-product-row-desc { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .ds-product-row-cta { position: absolute; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; color: #005647; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 24px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.35s; } .ds-product-row-cta:hover { transform: scale(1.15); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input / textarea used in the contact form.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,86,71,0.15); background: #f9faf8; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: #1c1c1c; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #666666; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #005647; outline: none; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Michroma headline with a short animated underline stroke in Bright Mint (or Deep Pine when emphasized) — the recurring section-intro pattern.
components.html: Todo lo que necesitás en un solo lugar
components.css: .ds-section-header-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Michroma', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.3; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem); color: #1c1c1c; } .ds-section-header-rule { display: block; margin-top: 8px; height: 2px; width: 64px; background: #00dba0; }

components.name: Living Network
components.description: Signature background motif: a canvas of small drifting, connecting nodes rendered behind nearly every page. This snippet is a static illustrative approximation only — the real implementation is an animated <canvas> (NeuralNetworkBackground.tsx), not CSS.
components.css: .ds-living-network { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.65; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 25%, rgba(0,164,120,0.5) 0 2px, transparent 2px), radial-gradient(circle at 45% 60%, rgba(0,164,120,0.5) 0 2.5px, transparent 2.5px), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 20%, rgba(0,164,120,0.5) 0 2px, transparent 2px), radial-gradient(circle at 85% 70%, rgba(0,164,120,0.5) 0 3px, transparent 3px), radial-gradient(circle at 30% 85%, rgba(0,164,120,0.5) 0 2px, transparent 2px); background-repeat: no-repeat; }

narrative.overview:
Tecnera is a calm, human workspace before it is a piece of technology. The foundation is a field office, not a control room: white floating cards, generous air, soft shadows, unhurried spacing. A visitor should feel like they've walked into a well-run, approachable company — never an intimidating enterprise dashboard, never a wall of gauges and metrics. This is deliberate: Tecnera doesn't sell monitoring software, it sells simplification, and the interface has to feel simpler than the operations it replaces.

Underneath that calm surface runs the second half of the system: a living network. A slow, softly-connecting mesh of nodes and lines drifts behind the content on nearly every page, quietly reinforcing that every product, page, and idea belongs to one intelligent, evolving ecosystem. It is atmosphere, not data-viz — there is no dashboard read to it, no implication of live metrics or monitoring. It should feel closer to Notion's calm productivity surfaces or Apple Intelligence's soft ambient glow than to a NOC screen.
keyCharacteristics: Human before corporate — soft white surfaces and generous whitespace, not dense enterprise chrome.
Intelligent before futuristic — the network is a quiet undercurrent, never a sci-fi or dashboard motif.
Calm before flashy — restraint is the default; loud effects are the exception, not the house style.
Connected before modular — every surface reads as one ecosystem.
Premium through simplicity — quality is communicated by what's left out, not by visual density.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Bright Mint is the only color allowed to say "act now." Warm Amber and Info Link are single-purpose exceptions for specific components, never general CTA colors.

rules.name: The One Display Moment Rule
rules.body: Michroma appears once per page as the hero/section headline generator — never in body copy, buttons, or dense UI text. Its rarity is what keeps it feeling special rather than gimmicky.

rules.name: The Floating-Not-Stacked Rule
rules.body: Cards read as resting gently above the network canvas, not as a stack of opaque panels. Backdrop-blur glass panels, not solid fills, are the preferred way to place text over the network when contrast is needed.

dos: Do keep the living network present and continuous across pages — it's the connective tissue of the brand, not a homepage-only flourish.
Do use full-pill shape for every clickable CTA; reserve square/rounded-xl corners for input fields and small icon tiles only.
Do use Bright Mint as the only "go" signal color; keep Warm Amber and Info Link scoped to their single existing contexts.
Do pair Michroma sparingly (one display/headline moment per section) with Nunito for everything readable.
Do favor backdrop-blur glass panels over solid fills when placing text on top of the network canvas.
donts: Don't introduce dashboard/control-room visual language (gauges, live-metric tickers, dense data grids as decoration) — the network is atmosphere, not a data visualization.
Don't extend the current heavy 3px text-stroke-and-glow hero treatment to new headlines; new display type should read closer to the calm Field Office foundation.
Don't carry the current shadow-black/30 heavy card shadow forward as the standard; new elevated surfaces should use a lighter, more diffused ambient shadow.
Don't use sharp/square corners anywhere in the primary UI.
Don't fabricate metrics, client counts, or case studies to fill empty sections — those numbers are placeholder, not fact.
